## Club career
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Pepe_\(footballer,_born_February_1983\)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Club career")]
### Marítimo
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Pepe_\(footballer,_born_February_1983\)&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Marítimo")]
Born in [Maceió](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macei%C3%B3 "Maceió"), [Alagoas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alagoas "Alagoas"), Pepe was named Kepler Laveran by his father in honour to scientists [Johannes Kepler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johannes_Kepler "Johannes Kepler") and [Charles Louis Alphonse Laveran](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Louis_Alphonse_Laveran "Charles Louis Alphonse Laveran").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pepe_\(footballer,_born_February_1983\)#cite_note-6) He started playing football with local [Corinthians Alagoano](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sport_Club_Corinthians_Alagoano "Sport Club Corinthians Alagoano"). At age 18, alongside teammate [Ezequias](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ezequias "Ezequias"), he moved to Portugal to sign with [Marítimo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C.S._Mar%C3%ADtimo "C.S. Marítimo") in [Madeira](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madeira "Madeira"), spending the vast majority of his first season with the [B-team](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C.S._Mar%C3%ADtimo_B "C.S. Marítimo B").
After being promoted to the main squad for the [2002–03 season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2002%E2%80%9303_Primeira_Liga "2002–03 Primeira Liga"), under Ukrainian manager [Anatoliy Byshovets](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anatoliy_Byshovets "Anatoliy Byshovets"), Pepe rarely missed a match, playing in several positions including [defensive midfielder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Midfielder#Defensive_midfielder "Midfielder").[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]
During the [2002–03 pre-season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2002%E2%80%9303_Primeira_Liga "2002–03 Primeira Liga"), Pepe was given permission to train with [Sporting CP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sporting_CP "Sporting CP") for two weeks, after which a deal could be negotiated for his transfer. However, neither club could agree on financial terms and the negotiations broke down, with the player returning[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pepe_\(footballer,_born_February_198

### Porto
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Pepe_\(footballer,_born_February_1983\)&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Porto")]
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Pepe_Porto.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail_unscaled)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Pepe_Porto.jpg)Pepe playing for [Porto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Porto "FC Porto") in 2006
In May 2004, shortly before the club sealed the league and [UEFA Champions League](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UEFA_Champions_League "UEFA Champions League"), Pepe signed for [Porto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Porto "FC Porto").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pepe_\(footballer,_born_February_1983\)#cite_note-8)
In [his first season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2004%E2%80%9305_Primeira_Liga "2004–05 Primeira Liga"), with Spanish coach [Víctor Fernández](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%C3%ADctor_Fern%C3%A1ndez "Víctor Fernández") at the helm, Pepe was mostly used as a backup player, playing under veterans [Pedro Emanuel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pedro_Emanuel "Pedro Emanuel"), [Jorge Costa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jorge_Costa_\(footballer\) "Jorge Costa \(footballer\)") and utility defender [Ricardo Costa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ricardo_Costa_\(footballer,_born_1981\) "Ricardo Costa \(footballer, born 1981\)"). However, in [the following year](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2005%E2%80%9306_Primeira_Liga "2005–06 Primeira Liga"), under the guidance of [Co Adriaanse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Co_Adriaanse "Co Adriaanse"), he had a breakthrough season, establishing himself as one of the best defenders in the domestic competition: the Dutchman often chose a [3–4–3 offensive system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Formation_\(association_football\) "Formation \(association football\)"), with the player often pitched as the only natural stopper.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_] Porto eventually won back-to-back leagues and the [Taça de Portugal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2005%E2%80%9306_Ta%C3%A7a_de_Portugal "2005–06 Taça de Portugal").

result.content: Com raízes familiares intimamente ligadas à fundação do clube, tanto com António Nicolau de Almeida como com José Monteiro da Costa, as conversas e convívios à volta do FC Porto marcaram os primeiros anos da vida do 32.º presidente da instituição. O orgulho em ser portista e a paixão pelo futebol cedo contagiaram um jovem que era presença assídua no Estádio das Antas.
